title: Mushrooms tell McKenna about hyperlight-drive ships

tellings.quote: Take a look at this passage from Terence McKenna's True Hallucinations, where he recounts to the best of his abilities what the mushrooms are trying to communicate to him.
he talks about a mushroom trip where the mushrooms say to him within my memory exist the blueprints for hyper light drives
tellings.difference: Says the mushrooms claimed to hold the blueprints for hyperlight drives in their memory, and gives no source text, where the story cites True Hallucinations.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell how mushrooms told McKenna about hyperlight drives.

as_told.title: McKenna's mushroom trip and hyperlight drive blueprints

tellings.quote: and he was having some like two week trip in the Amazon McKenna and he said that the the mushroom spoke to him and I think it's called the song of the mushroom or something the mushroom spoke to him and he said within my memory exists the knowledge for hyperlight drives
tellings.difference: Places the message during a two-week trip in the Amazon and has the mushroom say the knowledge exists within its memory.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell that McKenna's mushrooms communicated knowledge of hyperlight drives to him.

as_told.title: McKenna's mushroom speaks to him in the Amazon

plain: The writer Terence McKenna said that during a mushroom trip, the mushrooms spoke to him and told him that "within my memory exist the blueprints for hyper light drives," meaning ships that travel faster than light. Michels brings this up himself on three occasions, the first time reading from McKenna's book True Hallucinations, where McKenna tries to set down what the mushrooms were telling him. His later retellings shift a little: once he speaks of blueprints and names no book, and once he places the message on a two-week trip in the Amazon, saying the mushroom held the knowledge in its memory. The point of telling it is that the mushrooms might be something like an alien mind holding knowledge beyond ours.
